data.long_meaning: Bhhas is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhās’ meaning ‘speech’ or ‘voice’. It is a name of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring clarity in communication. The name Bhhas carries the meaning “Loud, Clear Speech” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhhas usually hope their child will grow to embody loud, clear speech and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Bhhas is also associated with various Hindu deities such as Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have the power of speech and communication.

The name also represents purity in speech, as speaking the truth is closely linked to leading a virtuous life in Hinduism.
